title: Database disk filled by WAL files
symptoms: Disk /var/lib/postgresql on db-primary is 95% full. pg_wal directory growing quickly. Replication slot inactive and WAL files not being recycled.
root_cause: An inactive replication slot or failing archive_command keeps PostgreSQL from deleting old WAL files.
impact: If the disk fills, PostgreSQL stops and the database goes down.
fix_steps: Drop slots that are no longer used, or fix the replica that stopped consuming.
Fix archive_command if archiving is failing.
prevention: Alert on replication slot lag and pg_wal size.
